name: Genesis-2
about: Genesis-2 (2007-028A), a station core, launched 2007 Jun 28. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (R).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2007 Jun 30), held fixed
